_comment: Each feature carries the triple: behavior (machine spec) + verification (how to confirm) + status. Prefer an executable verification_command for pass-state gating; keep human verification steps for GUI/manual flows. Harness gate: if Verified Completion Rate (passing / activated) < 1.0, do not activate new features.

status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Create a new conversation
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can click New Chat and see a fresh empty conversation.
features.behavior: Creating a conversation yields a new empty thread selected in the UI and persisted in state.
verification: Verify a new conversation appears in the sidebar.
Verify the main panel shows an empty conversation state.
features.notes: GUI flow — verification_command may stay empty; use manual verification steps.

features.title: Add item to cart
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can add an item and see it in the cart.
features.notes: Backend flow — prefer the executable verification_command for pass-state gating.

features.title: Persist the active conversation list
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees previously created conversations after restarting the app.
features.behavior: Conversations persist across an app restart and reload from storage on startup.
verification: Verify both conversations still appear in the sidebar.
